def workflow__overlay(base, generated):
    if generated.target_id.duplicated().any():
        raise ValueError('Duplicate generated target IDs')
    g = generated.set_index('target_id')
    out = base.copy()
    missing = set(out.target_id) - set(g.index)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError('Missing rebuilt targets: ' + str(sorted(missing)[:12]))
    updates = {col: out.target_id.map(g[col]).to_numpy() for col in g if col not in workflow.METRICS}
    return workflow.pd.concat([out.drop(columns=list(updates), errors='ignore').reset_index(drop=True), workflow.pd.DataFrame(updates)], axis=1)
workflow.overlay = workflow__overlay

def workflow__rebuild_features(axis, workspace):
    a = acquisition
    w = workflow.Path(workspace).resolve()
    prepared = a.prepare_inputs(axis, w, require_downloads=True, reset=True)
    seqmod = workflow.module('beyond', 'build_nonerror_features.py')
    shared = workflow.module('shared', 'analyze_shared_axes.py')
    ext = workflow.module('geometry', 'build_combined_and_score_axes.py')
    expanded = workflow.module('cys', 'expand_all_scored_features.py')
    freeze = workflow.module('beyond', 'freeze_followup_axes.py')
    reference = workflow.read(workflow.RUNS / workflow.NAMES['beyond'] / 'spectra_ready_dataset/prospective_features.followup.csv')
    cb = workflow.module('single', 'build_cameo_dataset.py')
    cb.ROOT = w
    cb.RAW = w / 'downloads/cameo'
    cb.OUT = w / 'processed/cameo'
    metadata = workflow.read(cb.RAW / 'meta.csv')

    class Train:

        def to_pandas(self):
            return metadata.copy()
    cb.load_dataset = lambda *args, **kwargs: {'train': Train()}
    cb.main()
    core = workflow.read(cb.OUT / 'candidate_features.csv')
    for column in ['pdb_path', 'msa_path']:
        core[column] = core[column].map(lambda p: str(w / p) if isinstance(p, str) and p else '')
    expected = reference.set_index('target_id').sequence
    if not core.apply(lambda r: r.sequence == expected[r.target_id], axis=1).all():
        raise ValueError('Source FASTA differs from cohort sequence')
    reference = workflow.overlay(reference, core)
    values = workflow.pd.DataFrame([seqmod.sequence_features(s) for s in reference.sequence])
    values.insert(0, 'target_id', reference.target_id)
    reference = workflow.overlay(reference, values)
    geometry = workflow.pd.DataFrame([seqmod.reference_structure_features(r) for _, r in reference.iterrows()])
    geometry.insert(0, 'target_id', reference.target_id)
    reference = workflow.overlay(reference, geometry)
    reference['submission_ordinal'] = workflow.pd.to_datetime(reference.submission_date, errors='coerce').map(lambda x: x.toordinal() if workflow.pd.notna(x) else workflow.np.nan)
    reference['flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank'] = freeze.rank_mean(reference, ['proline_fraction', 'chou_beta_minus_helix', 'chou_turn_minus_helix'])
    reference['nonhelical_topology_composite_rank'] = freeze.rank_mean(reference, ['chou_beta_minus_helix', 'chou_turn_minus_helix'])
    definitions = {}
    for filename in ['axis_definitions_prejoin.json', 'axis_definitions_followup.json']:
        specs = workflow.json.loads((workflow.RUNS / workflow.NAMES['beyond'] / filename).read_text())['axes']
        calculated = []
        for spec in specs:
            feature = spec['feature']
            if filename.endswith('followup.json'):
                fitted = freeze.add_quantile_levels(reference, feature, int(spec['n_bins']))
            elif feature == 'quaternary_state':
                fitted = seqmod.add_categorical_levels(reference, feature)
            else:
                fitted = seqmod.add_quantile_levels(reference, feature, 5)
            calculated.append({**spec, **fitted})
        definitions[filename] = {'axes': calculated}
    (w / 'processed').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    reference.to_csv(w / 'processed/reference_features.csv', index=False)
    for filename, value in definitions.items():
        workflow.dump(w / 'processed' / filename, value)
    primary = next((x for x in definitions['axis_definitions_followup.json']['axes'] if x['feature'] == 'flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank'))
    high_threshold = float(primary['level_stats'][-1]['min'])
    level_maps = {}
    for panel, group, pool_file, feature, level_column, direction in [('charge97', 'esmfold2_charge_axis_fresh_rcsb_confirmation_20260601T205925Z', 'eligible_unscored_charge_pool.csv', 'calc_seq_abs_charge_per_residue', 'charge_level', 1), ('acidic78', workflow.NAMES['acid'], 'eligible_unscored_acidic_window_pool.csv', 'max_negative_charge_window31', 'acidic_window_level', -1), ('cysteine95', workflow.NAMES['cys'], 'eligible_unscored_cys_pool.csv', 'cys_fraction', 'cys_level', 1)]:
        if panel not in prepared:
            continue
        pool = workflow.read(workflow.RUNS / group / 'spectra_ready_dataset' / pool_file)
        if panel == 'charge97':
            pool[feature] = pool.sequence.map(lambda s: shared.sequence_features(s)[feature])
        elif panel == 'acidic78':
            pool[feature] = pool.sequence.map(lambda s: seqmod.sequence_features(s)[feature])
        else:
            pool[feature] = pool.sequence.map(lambda s: str(s).upper().count('C') / len(str(s)))
        stress = workflow.pd.to_numeric(pool[feature], errors='coerce') * direction
        mask = stress.notna()
        pool[level_column] = workflow.np.nan
        pool.loc[mask, level_column] = workflow.pd.qcut(stress[mask].rank(method='first'), q=5, labels=False, duplicates='drop').astype(int)
        pool.to_csv(w / 'processed' / (panel + '_pool_levels.csv'), index=False)
        level_maps[panel] = (level_column, pool.set_index('target_id')[level_column])
    receipt = {'axis': int(axis), 'mode': 'raw_inputs_and_released_scores', 'panels': {}, 'reference_rows': len(reference), 'calibration': 'full CAMEO reference; input-side eligible pools for charge, acidic, cysteine'}
    for name, info in prepared.items():
        df = workflow.read(info['features'])
        if name.startswith('cameo'):
            df = workflow.overlay(df, reference[reference.target_id.isin(df.target_id)])
        values = workflow.pd.DataFrame([seqmod.sequence_features(s) for s in df.sequence])
        values.insert(0, 'target_id', df.target_id)
        df = workflow.overlay(df, values)
        extra = workflow.pd.DataFrame([shared.sequence_features(s) for s in df.sequence])
        extra.insert(0, 'target_id', df.target_id)
        df = workflow.overlay(df, extra)
        df['seq_len'] = df.sequence.str.len()
        if name == 'external34':
            df = ext.add_external_topology(df, w)
        df = ext.add_common_derived(ext.ensure_sequence_features(df), float(reference.seq_len.median()))
        df = expanded.add_expanded_features(df)
        if name in ['external34', 'flexible107']:
            eb = workflow.module('beyond', 'external_rcsb_same_bucket_expansion_20260531/scripts/build_external_rcsb_bucket_panel.py')
            features = ['proline_fraction', 'chou_beta_minus_helix', 'chou_turn_minus_helix']
            for feature in features:
                df[feature + '_prior_pct'] = df[feature].map(lambda x: eb.empirical_pct(reference[feature], x))
            df['flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank'] = df[[x + '_prior_pct' for x in features]].mean(axis=1)
            if name == 'flexible107':
                df['external_axis_level'] = workflow.np.searchsorted([0.3, 0.5, 0.65, high_threshold], df.flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank, side='right')
                df['external_axis_level_name'] = df.external_axis_level.map(lambda x: f'L{x}')
            else:
                df['axis_flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank_q7_level'] = workflow.np.where(df.flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank.ge(high_threshold), 6.0, workflow.np.nan)
        if name in level_maps:
            column, mapping = level_maps[name]
            df[column] = df.target_id.map(mapping)
            if df[column].isna().any():
                raise ValueError('Selected target missing from input-side level fit: ' + name)
            df[column] = df[column].astype(int)
            df[column + '_name'] = df[column].map(lambda x: f'L{x}')
        if name == 'acidic78':
            df['acidic_window_feature'] = df.max_negative_charge_window31
            df['acidic_window_stress'] = -df.max_negative_charge_window31
        if name in ['viral36', 'envelope38', 'surface45']:
            b = workflow.module('envelope', 'build_surface_lowhelical_confirmation_panel.py')
            df['disulfide_capacity_per100'] = df.sequence.map(b.disulfide_capacity_per100)
            df['tm_helix_proxy_calc'] = df.sequence.map(b.tm_proxy)
            df['nglyc_motif_count'] = df.sequence.map(b.nglyc_count)
            if name == 'surface45':
                df = workflow.overlay(df, workflow.pd.DataFrame([dict(target_id=r['target_id'], **b.axis_features(r)) for r in df.to_dict('records')]))
            elif name == 'envelope38':
                df['envelope_fusion_score'] = df.apply(workflow.module('envelope', 'build_envelope_fusion_confirmation_panel.py').level, axis=1)
            else:
                v = workflow.module(a.MANIFEST['panels'][name]['source_run_root'].split('/')[-1], 'build_viral_disulfide_pilot_panel.py')
                df['viral_disulfide_capacity_per100'] = df.sequence.map(v.disulfide_capacity_per100)
                df['viral_disulfide_score'] = df.apply(v.axis_score, axis=1)
        df = df.drop(columns=list(workflow.METRICS), errors='ignore')
        df.to_csv(info['features'], index=False)
        receipt['panels'][name] = {'features': info['features'], 'sha256': workflow.digest(info['features']), 'rows': len(df), 'recomputed_columns': sorted(set(values) | set(extra) | {'seq_len'})}
    workflow.dump(w / 'feature_calculation_report.json', receipt)
    return receipt
workflow.rebuild_features = workflow__rebuild_features

def workflow__shared_frames(job):
    if not hasattr(job, '_shared_frames'):
        m = workflow.module('shared', 'analyze_shared_axes.py')
        paths = {'cameo_followup_features': ('cameo', 'features.csv'), 'cameo_followup_results': ('cameo', 'target_model_results.csv'), 'cameo_scaled_results': ('cameo_scaled40', 'target_model_results.csv'), 'rcsb_orig_features': ('external34', 'features.csv'), 'rcsb_orig_results': ('external34', 'target_model_results.csv'), 'rcsb_exp_features': ('flexible107', 'features.csv'), 'rcsb_exp_results': ('flexible107', 'target_model_results.csv')}
        m.PATHS = {key: job.w / 'panels' / panel / file for key, (panel, file) in paths.items()}
        job._shared_frames = m.load_combined_tables()
    return job._shared_frames
workflow.shared_frames = workflow__shared_frames

def workflow__shared(job):
    df, targets, manifest = workflow.shared_frames(job)
    m = workflow.module('shared', 'analyze_shared_axes.py')
    job.save('shared_combined_prospective_performance.csv', df)
    job.save('shared_target_model_results.csv', targets)
    job.save('shared_input_manifest.json', manifest)
    features = m.numeric_candidate_features(df)
    summary, curves, dense = m.score_shared_axes(df, features)
    job.save('shared_candidate_summary.csv', summary)
    job.save('shared_candidate_curves.csv', curves)
    job.save('shared_candidate_dense.csv', dense)
workflow.shared = workflow__shared

4. Model results or released scores¶

ESMFold2 per-target evaluation rows are taken from the fingerprinted public package. These rows contain individual accuracy values and sampling settings; aggregate curves and decision reports are not read as answers. The input-feature tables computed above are joined to these measurements, including the released per-target extended-chain reference scores. No training or fine-tuning is performed.

model_scoring.pairwise2 = model_scoring__import_pairwise2
from Bio.PDB import PDBParser as model_scoring__import_PDBParser
model_scoring.PDBParser = model_scoring__import_PDBParser
from Bio.SVDSuperimposer import SVDSuperimposer as model_scoring__import_SVDSuperimposer
model_scoring.SVDSuperimposer = model_scoring__import_SVDSuperimposer
model_scoring.ROOT = model_scoring.Path(model_scoring.__file__).resolve().parents[1]
model_scoring.AA3 = {'ALA': 'A', 'ARG': 'R', 'ASN': 'N', 'ASP': 'D', 'CYS': 'C', 'GLN': 'Q', 'GLU': 'E', 'GLY': 'G', 'HIS': 'H', 'ILE': 'I', 'LEU': 'L', 'LYS': 'K', 'MET': 'M', 'PHE': 'F', 'PRO': 'P', 'SER': 'S', 'THR': 'T', 'TRP': 'W', 'TYR': 'Y', 'VAL': 'V', 'SEC': 'U', 'PYL': 'O'}
model_scoring.RESULT_COLUMNS = ['target_id', 'status', 'error', 'wall_sec', 'ptm', 'plddt_mean', 'plddt_ca_mean', 'alignment_identity', 'alignment_coverage', 'aligned_ca', 'ca_lddt', 'ca_rmsd', 'gdt_ts', 'ca_median_error', 'ca_p90_error', 'baseline_ca_lddt', 'baseline_gdt_ts', 'baseline_ca_rmsd']

def model_scoring__configure_torch() -> None:
    model_scoring.os.environ.setdefault('TORCH_CUDNN_SDPA_ENABLED', '0')
    try:
        model_scoring.torch.backends.cuda.enable_cudnn_sdp(False)
        model_scoring.torch.backends.cuda.enable_flash_sdp(False)
        model_scoring.torch.backends.cuda.enable_mem_efficient_sdp(False)
        model_scoring.torch.backends.cuda.enable_math_sdp(True)
    except Exception:
        pass
model_scoring.configure_torch = model_scoring__configure_torch

def model_scoring__ref_ca(path: model_scoring.Path, chain_id: str) -> tuple[str, model_scoring.np.ndarray]:
    parser = model_scoring.PDBParser(QUIET=True)
    structure = parser.get_structure(path.stem, str(path))
    model = next(structure.get_models())
    seq = []
    coords = []
    actual_chain = chain_id
    if actual_chain not in model:
        chains = list(model)
        nonempty = [c for c in chains if sum((1 for r in c if 'CA' in r)) > 0]
        if len(nonempty) == 1:
            actual_chain = nonempty[0].id
    for res in model[actual_chain]:
        hetflag, _resseq, _icode = res.id
        if hetflag.strip() or 'CA' not in res:
            continue
        seq.append(model_scoring.AA3.get(res.resname.upper(), 'X'))
        coords.append(res['CA'].get_coord().astype(model_scoring.np.float32))
    return (''.join(seq), model_scoring.np.asarray(coords, dtype=model_scoring.np.float32))
model_scoring.ref_ca = model_scoring__ref_ca

def model_scoring__pred_ca_from_output(output: dict) -> model_scoring.np.ndarray:
    coords = output['sample_atom_coords']
    if coords.dim() == 4:
        coords = coords[:, 0]
    coords = coords.detach().float().cpu().numpy()[0]
    atom_to_token = output['atom_to_token'].detach().cpu().numpy()
    ref_chars = output['ref_atom_name_chars'].detach().cpu().numpy()
    atom_mask = output['atom_attention_mask'].detach().cpu().numpy().astype(bool)
    token_mask = output['token_attention_mask'].detach().cpu().numpy().astype(bool)
    if atom_to_token.ndim == 2:
        atom_to_token = atom_to_token[0]
        ref_chars = ref_chars[0]
        atom_mask = atom_mask[0]
        token_mask = token_mask[0]
    n = int(token_mask.sum())
    out = model_scoring.np.full((n, 3), model_scoring.np.nan, dtype=model_scoring.np.float32)
    for i in range(atom_to_token.shape[0]):
        if not atom_mask[i]:
            continue
        name = ''.join((chr(int(c) + 32) if int(c) != 0 else ' ' for c in ref_chars[i])).strip()
        if name == 'CA':
            tok = int(atom_to_token[i])
            if 0 <= tok < n:
                out[tok] = coords[i]
    return out
model_scoring.pred_ca_from_output = model_scoring__pred_ca_from_output

def model_scoring__alignment_pairs(query: str, ref: str) -> tuple[list[tuple[int, int]], float, float]:
    aln = model_scoring.pairwise2.align.globalms(query, ref, 2, -1, -10, -0.5, one_alignment_only=True)[0]
    qi = ri = 0
    pairs = []
    matches = 0
    both = 0
    for a, b in zip(aln.seqA, aln.seqB):
        qpos = qi if a != '-' else None
        rpos = ri if b != '-' else None
        if a != '-':
            qi += 1
        if b != '-':
            ri += 1
        if qpos is not None and rpos is not None:
            pairs.append((qpos, rpos))
            both += 1
            matches += int(a == b)
    identity = matches / both if both else 0.0
    coverage = both / max(1, len(query))
    return (pairs, identity, coverage)
model_scoring.alignment_pairs = model_scoring__alignment_pairs

def model_scoring__kabsch_metrics(pred: model_scoring.np.ndarray, ref: model_scoring.np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float]:
    sup = model_scoring.SVDSuperimposer()
    sup.set(ref.astype(model_scoring.np.float64), pred.astype(model_scoring.np.float64))
    sup.run()
    pred_fit = sup.get_transformed()
    d = model_scoring.np.linalg.norm(pred_fit - ref, axis=1)
    return {'ca_rmsd': float(sup.get_rms()), 'gdt_ts': float(model_scoring.np.mean([model_scoring.np.mean(d < t) for t in (1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0)])), 'ca_median_error': float(model_scoring.np.median(d)), 'ca_p90_error': float(model_scoring.np.quantile(d, 0.9))}
model_scoring.kabsch_metrics = model_scoring__kabsch_metrics

def model_scoring__ca_lddt(pred: model_scoring.np.ndarray, ref: model_scoring.np.ndarray, cutoff: float=15.0) -> float:
    n = len(ref)
    if n < 2:
        return float('nan')
    diff_ref = ref[:, None, :] - ref[None, :, :]
    diff_pred = pred[:, None, :] - pred[None, :, :]
    d_ref = model_scoring.np.linalg.norm(diff_ref, axis=-1)
    d_pred = model_scoring.np.linalg.norm(diff_pred, axis=-1)
    mask = model_scoring.np.triu((d_ref > 0) & (d_ref < cutoff), 1)
    if not model_scoring.np.any(mask):
        return float('nan')
    delta = model_scoring.np.abs(d_ref[mask] - d_pred[mask])
    return float(model_scoring.np.mean([(delta < t).mean() for t in (0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0)]))
model_scoring.ca_lddt = model_scoring__ca_lddt

def model_scoring__extended_chain(n: int) -> model_scoring.np.ndarray:
    coords = model_scoring.np.zeros((n, 3), dtype=model_scoring.np.float32)
    coords[:, 0] = model_scoring.np.arange(n, dtype=model_scoring.np.float32) * 3.8
    return coords
model_scoring.extended_chain = model_scoring__extended_chain

def model_scoring__score_prediction(query: str, pred_ca: model_scoring.np.ndarray, ref_seq: str, ref_coords: model_scoring.np.ndarray) -> dict[str, float]:
    pairs, ident, cov = model_scoring.alignment_pairs(query, ref_seq)
    valid = [(q, r) for q, r in pairs if q < len(pred_ca) and r < len(ref_coords) and model_scoring.np.isfinite(pred_ca[q]).all()]
    if len(valid) < 30:
        return {'alignment_identity': ident, 'alignment_coverage': cov, 'aligned_ca': len(valid), 'ca_lddt': model_scoring.np.nan, 'gdt_ts': model_scoring.np.nan, 'ca_rmsd': model_scoring.np.nan, 'baseline_ca_lddt': model_scoring.np.nan, 'baseline_gdt_ts': model_scoring.np.nan, 'baseline_ca_rmsd': model_scoring.np.nan}
    qidx = model_scoring.np.asarray([q for q, _r in valid], dtype=int)
    ridx = model_scoring.np.asarray([r for _q, r in valid], dtype=int)
    pred = pred_ca[qidx]
    ref = ref_coords[ridx]
    metrics = {'alignment_identity': ident, 'alignment_coverage': cov, 'aligned_ca': len(valid), 'ca_lddt': model_scoring.ca_lddt(pred, ref)}
    metrics.update(model_scoring.kabsch_metrics(pred, ref))
    baseline = model_scoring.extended_chain(len(valid))
    metrics['baseline_ca_lddt'] = model_scoring.ca_lddt(baseline, ref)
    base_k = model_scoring.kabsch_metrics(baseline, ref)
    metrics['baseline_gdt_ts'] = base_k['gdt_ts']
    metrics['baseline_ca_rmsd'] = base_k['ca_rmsd']
    return metrics
model_scoring.score_prediction = model_scoring__score_prediction


def predict_and_score(sequence, reference_path, reference_chain, model_directory, loops=3, steps=14, samples=1, seed=0):
    """Run the public model implementation and calculate accuracy from coordinates."""
    import torch
    from transformers import EsmFold2Model
    from transformers.models.esmfold2.protein_utils import prepare_protein_features
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    if not torch.cuda.is_available():raise RuntimeError('This inference function requires an available CUDA GPU')
    model_scoring.torch=torch
    model_scoring.configure_torch()
    model,loading=EsmFold2Model.from_pretrained(model_directory,output_loading_info=True)
    problems={key:value for key,value in loading.items() if key in ['missing_keys','unexpected_keys','mismatched_keys','error_msgs','conversion_errors','skipped_pp_keys'] and value}
    if problems:raise RuntimeError('Incomplete model loading: '+str(problems))
    model=model.cuda().eval()
    model.esmc.to(torch.bfloat16)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    features=prepare_protein_features(sequence,device=model.device)
    with torch.inference_mode():
        output=model.fold(**features,num_loops=loops,num_sampling_steps=steps,num_diffusion_samples=samples)
    values=dict(output)
    for key in ['atom_to_token','ref_atom_name_chars','atom_attention_mask']:values[key]=features[key]
    values['token_attention_mask']=features['attention_mask']
    coordinates=model_scoring.pred_ca_from_output(values)
    reference_sequence,reference_coordinates=model_scoring.ref_ca(Path(reference_path),reference_chain)
    return model_scoring.score_prediction(sequence,coordinates,reference_sequence,reference_coordinates)

def workflow__digest(path):
    h = workflow.hashlib.sha256()
    with workflow.Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
workflow.digest = workflow__digest

def workflow__dump(path, value):
    p = workflow.Path(path)
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(workflow.json.dumps(value, indent=2, default=lambda x: x.item() if hasattr(x, 'item') else str(x)) + '\n')
    return str(p)

    return a._module(p)

def workflow__overlay(base, generated):
    if generated.target_id.duplicated().any():
        raise ValueError('Duplicate generated target IDs')
    g = generated.set_index('target_id')
    out = base.copy()
    missing = set(out.target_id) - set(g.index)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError('Missing rebuilt targets: ' + str(sorted(missing)[:12]))
    updates = {col: out.target_id.map(g[col]).to_numpy() for col in g if col not in workflow.METRICS}
    return workflow.pd.concat([out.drop(columns=list(updates), errors='ignore').reset_index(drop=True), workflow.pd.DataFrame(updates)], axis=1)
workflow.overlay = workflow__overlay

def workflow__require_features(axis, workspace):
    a = acquisition
    w = workflow.Path(workspace)
    p = w / 'feature_calculation_report.json'
    if not p.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError('Run input calculation before inference/analysis: ' + str(p))
    receipt = workflow.json.loads(p.read_text())
    out = {}
    for name in a.panels_for(axis):
        if name not in receipt.get('panels', {}):
            raise ValueError('Missing calculated panel ' + name)
        item = receipt['panels'][name]
        f = w / 'panels' / name / 'features.csv'
        if not f.is_file() or workflow.digest(f) != item['sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Calculated features missing or changed: ' + str(f))
        out[name] = {'features': str(f), 'results': str(f.parent / 'target_model_results.csv'), 'n_original_targets': item['rows']}
    return out
workflow.require_features = workflow__require_features

def workflow__validate_results(axis, workspace):
    a = acquisition
    prepared = workflow.require_features(axis, workspace)
    checks = {}
    for name, info in prepared.items():
        p = workflow.Path(info['results'])
        if not p.is_file():
            raise FileNotFoundError('Inference results missing for ' + name + ': ' + str(p))
        f = workflow.read(info['features'])
        r = workflow.read(p)
        settings = a.MANIFEST['panels'][name]['inference']
        eligible = f.seq_len.le(settings['max_len'])
        if 'eligible_reference' in f:
            eligible &= f.eligible_reference.fillna(False).astype(bool)
        expected = set(f.loc[eligible, 'target_id'])
        observed = set(r.target_id)
        if expected - observed:
            raise ValueError('Incomplete ' + name + ' results: ' + str(sorted(expected - observed)))
        if observed - set(f.target_id):
            raise ValueError('Unexpected result targets in ' + name)
        ok = r.status.eq('ok')
        if not r.loc[ok, 'ca_lddt'].notna().any():
            raise ValueError('No finite successful accuracy values in ' + name)
        n = settings['num_diffusion_samples']
        if n > 1:
            for target, g in r.groupby('target_id'):
                if g.status.eq('ok').any() and set(workflow.pd.to_numeric(g.sample_index, errors='coerce').dropna().astype(int)) != set(range(n)):
                    raise ValueError('Incomplete sample set: ' + name + '/' + str(target))
        checks[name] = {'rows': len(r), 'successful_rows': int(ok.sum()), 'failed_rows': int((~ok).sum()), 'nonfinite_accuracy_rows': int(r.ca_lddt.isna().sum()), 'result_sha256': workflow.digest(p), 'features_sha256': workflow.digest(info['features'])}
        if not ok.any():
            raise ValueError('No successful model evaluations in ' + name)
    workflow.dump(workflow.Path(workspace) / 'result_completeness.json', checks)
    return checks
workflow.validate_results = workflow__validate_results

def workflow__select(r, policy='best_by_ptm'):
    if 'sample_index' not in r:
        return r.drop_duplicates('target_id').copy()
    sample = workflow.pd.to_numeric(r.sample_index, errors='coerce')
    ok = r[r.status.fillna('ok').eq('ok') & sample.ge(0)].copy()
    if policy == 'first_sample':
        return ok[workflow.pd.to_numeric(ok.sample_index, errors='coerce').eq(0)].copy()
    col = {'best_by_ptm': 'ptm', 'best_by_plddt': 'plddt_mean', 'oracle_best_ca_lddt': 'ca_lddt'}[policy]
    ok[col] = workflow.pd.to_numeric(ok[col], errors='coerce')
    return ok.sort_values(['target_id', col, 'sample_index'], ascending=[True, False, True]).groupby('target_id', as_index=False).head(1)
workflow.select = workflow__select

class workflow__Analysis:

    def __init__(self, axis, workspace):
        a = acquisition
        self.a = a
        self.axis = int(axis)
        self.w = workflow.Path(workspace).resolve()
        self.out = self.w / 'analysis' / f'axis-{self.axis:02}'
        self.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.checks = workflow.validate_results(axis, self.w)
        self.f = {}
        self.r = {}
        self.selected = {}
        self.artifacts = {}
        for name, info in workflow.require_features(axis, self.w).items():
            self.f[name] = workflow.read(info['features'])
            self.r[name] = workflow.read(info['results'])
            self.selected[name] = workflow.select(self.r[name]).set_index('target_id')

    def save(self, name, value):
        p = self.out / name
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if isinstance(value, workflow.pd.DataFrame):
            value.to_csv(p, index=False)
        else:
            workflow.dump(p, value)
        self.artifacts[name] = str(p)
        return p

    def panel_for(self, row):
        target = row['target_id']
        text = ' '.join((str(row.get(k, '')) for k in ['result_file', 'evidence_source', 'target_result_origin', 'feature_panel', 'result_panel', 'dataset', 'evaluation_pool', 'inference_setting', 'source', 'source_group', 'panel'])).lower()
        rules = [(['surface_lowhelical'], 'surface45'), (['envelope_fusion'], 'envelope38'), (['viral_disulfide'], 'viral36'), (['cys_confirmation', 'cysteine', 'fresh_cys', 'all_scored_evidence'], 'cysteine95'), (['acidic_window'], 'acidic78'), (['fresh_charge', 'charge_confirmation', 'charge_axis_fresh'], 'charge97'), (['expanded_107', 'flexible_axis_expanded'], 'flexible107'), (['original_34', 'external_rcsb_same_bucket', 'external_rcsb'], 'external34'), (['5seeds'], 'cameo_scaled14'), (['cameo_scaled', 'scaled_matched', 'top_tail', '5samples_full'], 'cameo_scaled40'), (['cameo', 'single_controller', 'beyond_evolutionary_support_20260531'], 'cameo')]
        for words, name in rules:
            if any((k in text for k in words)) and name in self.f and (target in set(self.f[name].target_id)):
                return name
        candidates = [n for n, f in self.f.items() if target in set(f.target_id)]
        if len(candidates) == 1:
            return candidates[0]
        if 'rcsb_scaled_combined' in text:
            for n in ['flexible107', 'external34']:
                if n in candidates:
                    return n
        raise ValueError('Ambiguous/missing outcome lineage for ' + str(target) + ': ' + str(candidates) + ' ' + text)

    def joined(self, name, policy='best_by_ptm'):
        f = self.f[name].drop(columns=list(workflow.METRICS), errors='ignore')
        r = workflow.select(self.r[name], policy)
        return f.merge(r, on='target_id', how='inner', suffixes=('', '_metric'), validate='one_to_one')

    def refresh(self, template):
        rows = []
        for _, row in template.iterrows():
            if str(row.get('evidence_source', '')) == 'RCSB_scaled_combined':
                combined = workflow.shared_frames(self)[0]
                current = combined[(combined.source == 'RCSB') & (combined.target_id == row.target_id)]
                if len(current) != 1:
                    raise ValueError('Missing/ambiguous regenerated shared RCSB target ' + str(row.target_id))
                current = current.iloc[0]
                d = row.to_dict()
                for c in workflow.METRICS:
                    if c in d:
                        d[c] = workflow.np.nan
                for c, v in current.items():
                    if (c in d or c in workflow.METRICS) and c not in ['evidence_source', 'evidence_root', 'analysis_id', 'combined_row_id']:
                        d[c] = v
                d['_rerun_panel'] = {'original_34': 'external34', 'expanded_107': 'flexible107'}[current.result_panel]
                rows.append(d)
                continue
            name = self.panel_for(row)
            target = row.target_id
            fresh = self.f[name].set_index('target_id').loc[target]
            d = row.to_dict()
            for c in fresh.index:
                if c not in workflow.METRICS and c in d and (not c.startswith('axis_')) and (c not in workflow.FROZEN_METADATA):
                    d[c] = fresh[c]
            for c in workflow.METRICS:
                if c in d:
                    d[c] = workflow.np.nan
            selected = self.selected[name]
            if str(row.get('dataset', '')) in ['cameo_scaled', 'external_rcsb']:
                if not hasattr(self, '_geometry_selected'):
                    self._geometry_selected = {}
                if name not in self._geometry_selected:
                    m = workflow.module('geometry', 'build_combined_and_score_axes.py')
                    self._geometry_selected[name] = m.aggregate_scaled_results(self.w / 'panels' / name / 'target_model_results.csv', str(row.get('evaluation_pool', ''))).set_index('target_id')
                selected = self._geometry_selected[name]
            if target not in selected.index:
                raise ValueError('Missing evaluated outcome ' + name + '/' + target)
            d.update({c: v for c, v in selected.loc[target].items() if c in workflow.METRICS})
            d['_rerun_panel'] = name
            rows.append(d)
        return workflow.pd.DataFrame(rows)

    @workflow.contextmanager
    def cwd(self):
        old = workflow.Path.cwd()
        workflow.os.chdir(self.out)
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            workflow.os.chdir(old)

    def original_main(self, group, filename, overrides=None):
        m = workflow.module(group, filename)
        orig = workflow.RUNS / workflow.NAMES.get(group, group)
        for key, val in list(vars(m).items()):
            if isinstance(val, workflow.Path):
                text = str(val)
                if str(orig) in text:
                    setattr(m, key, self.out / val.relative_to(orig))
                elif '/ewsc/yektefai/spectra_runs/' + workflow.NAMES.get(group, group) in text:
                    setattr(m, key, self.out / text.split('/ewsc/yektefai/spectra_runs/' + workflow.NAMES.get(group, group) + '/', 1)[-1])
        for k, v in (overrides or {}).items():
            setattr(m, k, v)
        with self.cwd(), workflow.redirect_stdout(workflow.io.StringIO()) as output:
            m.main()
        self.save(filename + '.stdout.txt', {'stdout': output.getvalue()})
        return m
workflow.Analysis = workflow__Analysis

def workflow__confirmation(job, name):
    panel = job.a.MANIFEST['panels'][name]
    group = panel['source_run_root'].split('/')[-1]
    specs = {'flexible107': ('summarize_expanded_external_spc.py', 'flex'), 'charge97': ('summarize_charge_confirmation.py', 'charge'), 'acidic78': ('summarize_acidic_window_confirmation.py', 'acid'), 'cysteine95': ('summarize_cys_confirmation.py', 'cys'), 'viral36': ('summarize_viral_disulfide_pilot.py', 'viral'), 'envelope38': ('summarize_envelope_fusion_confirmation.py', 'env'), 'surface45': ('summarize_surface_lowhelical_confirmation.py', 'surface')}
    filename, kind = specs[name]
    m = workflow.module(group, filename)
    curves = []
    effects = []
    targets = []
    for policy in ['best_by_ptm', 'best_by_plddt', 'oracle_best_ca_lddt', 'first_sample']:
        f = job.f[name]
        r = job.r[name]
        if kind in ['flex', 'charge']:
            if policy == 'first_sample':
                chosen = m.first_sample(r) if kind == 'charge' else r[r.sample_index.eq(0) & r.status.eq('ok')].copy()
            else:
                chosen = m.best_by(r, {'best_by_ptm': 'ptm', 'best_by_plddt': 'plddt_mean', 'oracle_best_ca_lddt': 'ca_lddt'}[policy])
            c, e = m.summarize(policy, chosen, f) if kind == 'flex' else m.summarize_selection(policy, chosen, f)
            d = f.drop(columns=list(workflow.METRICS), errors='ignore').merge(chosen, on='target_id', how='inner', suffixes=('', '_metric'), validate='one_to_one')
        elif kind in ['acid', 'env']:
            c, e, d = m.summarize_selection(f, r, policy)
        elif kind == 'cys':
            d, c, e = m.summarize_policy(f, r, policy)
        elif kind == 'viral':
            c, e = m.summarize_selection(f, r, policy)
            d = f.drop(columns=list(workflow.METRICS), errors='ignore').merge(m.select_rows(r, policy), on='target_id', how='inner', suffixes=('', '_metric'), validate='one_to_one')
        else:
            c, e, d = m.summarize_policy(f, r, policy)
        c = c.copy()
        c['selection'] = policy
        d = d.copy()
        d['selection'] = policy
        curves.append(c)
        effects.append(e)
        targets.append(d)
    job.save(name + '_curves.csv', workflow.pd.concat(curves, ignore_index=True))
    job.save(name + '_effects.json', effects)
    job.save(name + '_target_level.csv', workflow.pd.concat(targets, ignore_index=True))
workflow.confirmation = workflow__confirmation

def workflow__flexible(job):
    f = workflow.overlay(workflow.read(workflow.RUNS / workflow.NAMES['beyond'] / 'spectra_ready_dataset/prospective_features.followup.csv'), job.f['cameo'])
    fp = job.save('followup_features.csv', f.drop(columns=list(workflow.METRICS), errors='ignore'))
    rp = job.save('cameo_results.csv', job.r['cameo'])
    for filename, definition in [('score_axes.py', 'axis_definitions_prejoin.json'), ('score_followup_axes.py', 'axis_definitions_followup.json')]:
        definition_path = job.out / definition
        workflow.shutil.copyfile(job.w / 'processed' / definition, definition_path)
        job.original_main('beyond', filename, {'ROOT': job.out, 'FEATURE_CSV': fp, 'RESULTS_CSV': rp, 'AXIS_JSON': definition_path})
    for name in ['spectral_curves_all_axes.csv', 'axis_summary.csv', 'followup_axis_curves.csv', 'followup_axis_summary.csv', 'control_analysis.json']:
        job.artifacts[name] = str(job.out / name)
    for filename in ['densify_primary_axis.py', 'mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.py']:
        job.original_main('beyond', filename, {'ROOT': job.out, 'FEATURE_CSV': fp, 'RESULTS_CSV': rp})
    for name in ['primary_axis_decile_curve.csv', 'primary_axis_threshold_sweep.csv', 'primary_axis_densification.json', 'outcome_informed_hypotheses.json']:
        job.artifacts[name] = str(job.out / name)
    workflow.confirmation(job, 'flexible107')

def workflow__shared_frames(job):

        m = workflow.module('shared', 'analyze_shared_axes.py')
        paths = {'cameo_followup_features': ('cameo', 'features.csv'), 'cameo_followup_results': ('cameo', 'target_model_results.csv'), 'cameo_scaled_results': ('cameo_scaled40', 'target_model_results.csv'), 'rcsb_orig_features': ('external34', 'features.csv'), 'rcsb_orig_results': ('external34', 'target_model_results.csv'), 'rcsb_exp_features': ('flexible107', 'features.csv'), 'rcsb_exp_results': ('flexible107', 'target_model_results.csv')}
        m.PATHS = {key: job.w / 'panels' / panel / file for key, (panel, file) in paths.items()}

# Score axes
score_axes = SimpleNamespace(__file__=str(DATA_ROOT / 'original_runs/esmfold2_beyond_evolutionary_support_final_run/scripts/score_axes.py'))
import json as score_axes__import_json
score_axes.json = score_axes__import_json
from pathlib import Path as score_axes__import_Path
score_axes.Path = score_axes__import_Path
import numpy as score_axes__import_np
score_axes.np = score_axes__import_np
import pandas as score_axes__import_pd
score_axes.pd = score_axes__import_pd
score_axes.ROOT = score_axes.Path(score_axes.__file__).resolve().parents[1]
score_axes.FEATURE_CSV = score_axes.ROOT / 'spectra_ready_dataset' / 'prospective_features.csv'
score_axes.RESULTS_CSV = score_axes.ROOT / 'target_model_results.csv'
score_axes.AXIS_JSON = score_axes.ROOT / 'axis_definitions_prejoin.json'
score_axes.LEDGER_JSON = score_axes.ROOT / 'axis_ledger.json'
score_axes.CURVES_CSV = score_axes.ROOT / 'spectral_curves_all_axes.csv'
score_axes.SUMMARY_CSV = score_axes.ROOT / 'axis_summary.csv'
score_axes.STATE_JSON = score_axes.ROOT / 'spectra_loop_state.json'
score_axes.PRIMARY_METRIC = 'ca_lddt'
score_axes.SECONDARY_METRICS = ['gdt_ts', 'ca_rmsd']
score_axes.BASELINE_FOR = {'ca_lddt': 'baseline_ca_lddt', 'gdt_ts': 'baseline_gdt_ts', 'ca_rmsd': 'baseline_ca_rmsd'}
score_axes.CONTROL_COLS_CORE = ['seq_len', 'msa_log10_nonquery_rows']
score_axes.CONTROL_COLS_BROAD = ['seq_len', 'msa_log10_nonquery_rows', 'msa_top_nonquery_identity', 'difficulty']

def score_axes__zscore(s: score_axes.pd.Series) -> score_axes.pd.Series:
    s = score_axes.pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    sd = s.std(ddof=0)
    if not score_axes.np.isfinite(sd) or sd == 0:
        return s * 0.0
    return (s - s.mean()) / sd
score_axes.zscore = score_axes__zscore

def score_axes__ols_coef(df: score_axes.pd.DataFrame, y_col: str, stress_col: str, controls: list[str]) -> dict[str, float]:
    cols = [y_col, stress_col] + controls
    sub = df[cols].copy()
    for col in cols:
        sub[col] = score_axes.pd.to_numeric(sub[col], errors='coerce')
    sub = sub.dropna()
    if len(sub) < max(15, len(cols) * 4):
        return {'n': len(sub), 'coef': float('nan'), 'partial_corr': float('nan')}
    y = sub[y_col].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    x_stress = score_axes.zscore(sub[stress_col]).to_numpy(dtype=float)
    x_controls = [score_axes.zscore(sub[c]).to_numpy(dtype=float) for c in controls]
    X = score_axes.np.column_stack([score_axes.np.ones(len(sub)), x_stress] + x_controls)
    beta, *_ = score_axes.np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
    C = score_axes.np.column_stack([score_axes.np.ones(len(sub))] + x_controls)
    by, *_ = score_axes.np.linalg.lstsq(C, y, rcond=None)
    bs, *_ = score_axes.np.linalg.lstsq(C, x_stress, rcond=None)
    y_res = y - C @ by
    s_res = x_stress - C @ bs
    if score_axes.np.std(y_res) == 0 or score_axes.np.std(s_res) == 0:
        pcorr = float('nan')
    else:
        pcorr = float(score_axes.np.corrcoef(y_res, s_res)[0, 1])
    return {'n': int(len(sub)), 'coef': float(beta[1]), 'partial_corr': pcorr}
score_axes.ols_coef = score_axes__ols_coef

def score_axes__stress_rank_for_axis(df: score_axes.pd.DataFrame, axis: dict[str, object]) -> score_axes.pd.Series:
    level_col = axis['level_column']
    raw = df[level_col]
    if axis['feature'] == 'quaternary_state':
        return score_axes.pd.to_numeric(raw, errors='coerce')
    levels = score_axes.pd.to_numeric(raw, errors='coerce')
    max_level = levels.max()
    if axis.get('stress_direction') == 'low':
        return max_level - levels
    return levels
score_axes.stress_rank_for_axis = score_axes__stress_rank_for_axis

def score_axes__monotonicity(level_df: score_axes.pd.DataFrame, metric: str) -> float:
    if len(level_df) < 3:
        return float('nan')
    return float(level_df['stress_rank'].corr(level_df[metric], method='spearman'))
score_axes.monotonicity = score_axes__monotonicity

def score_axes__endpoint_effect(level_df: score_axes.pd.DataFrame, metric: str) -> float:
    if len(level_df) < 2:
        return float('nan')
    ordered = level_df.sort_values('stress_rank')
    return float(ordered.iloc[-1][metric] - ordered.iloc[0][metric])
score_axes.endpoint_effect = score_axes__endpoint_effect

def score_axes__classify_axis(summary: dict[str, object]) -> str:
    if not summary['split_valid']:
        return 'invalid'
    effect = summary['ca_lddt_endpoint_effect']
    broad = summary['ca_lddt_broad_adjusted_coef']
    rho = summary['ca_lddt_level_spearman']
    baseline_effect = summary['baseline_ca_lddt_endpoint_effect']
    n_min = summary['min_level_n']
    if not score_axes.np.isfinite(effect) or n_min < 8:
        return 'invalid'
    target_degrades = effect <= -0.08 and broad <= -0.025
    monotone_or_threshold = rho <= -0.55 or summary['ca_lddt_worst_level_drop'] <= -0.1
    baseline_not_same = not score_axes.np.isfinite(baseline_effect) or baseline_effect > effect * 0.5
    if target_degrades and monotone_or_threshold and baseline_not_same:
        return 'valid_candidate'
    if effect <= -0.04 or broad <= -0.015 or summary['ca_lddt_worst_level_drop'] <= -0.08:
        return 'weak'
    return 'negative'
score_axes.classify_axis = score_axes__classify_axis

def score_axes__main() -> None:
    features = score_axes.pd.read_csv(score_axes.FEATURE_CSV)
    results = score_axes.pd.read_csv(score_axes.RESULTS_CSV)
    axes = score_axes.json.loads(score_axes.AXIS_JSON.read_text())['axes']
    merged = features.merge(results, on='target_id', how='inner', validate='one_to_one')
    merged = merged[merged['status'].eq('ok')].copy()
    merged['log_seq_len'] = score_axes.np.log10(score_axes.pd.to_numeric(merged['seq_len'], errors='coerce'))
    curve_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    summaries: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    ledger_entries: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for axis in axes:
        if axis.get('status') != 'frozen':
            ledger_entries.append({**axis, 'decision': 'invalid'})
            continue
        level_col = axis['level_column']
        if level_col not in merged.columns:
            ledger_entries.append({**axis, 'decision': 'invalid', 'reason': 'missing_level_col'})
            continue
        work = merged.copy()
        work['stress_rank'] = score_axes.stress_rank_for_axis(work, axis)
        work = work.dropna(subset=['stress_rank', score_axes.PRIMARY_METRIC])
        grouped = []
        for stress_rank, g in work.groupby('stress_rank', dropna=True):
            row = {'axis_id': axis['axis_id'], 'feature': axis['feature'], 'axis_type': axis['type'], 'prospective': axis['prospective'], 'benchmark_only': axis['benchmark_only'], 'stress_direction': axis['stress_direction'], 'stress_rank': float(stress_rank), 'n': int(len(g)), 'feature_median': float(score_axes.pd.to_numeric(g[axis['feature']], errors='coerce').median()), 'seq_len_median': float(score_axes.pd.to_numeric(g['seq_len'], errors='coerce').median()), 'msa_log10_nonquery_rows_median': float(score_axes.pd.to_numeric(g['msa_log10_nonquery_rows'], errors='coerce').median()), 'difficulty_mean': float(score_axes.pd.to_numeric(g['difficulty'], errors='coerce').mean())}
            for metric in [score_axes.PRIMARY_METRIC] + score_axes.SECONDARY_METRICS:
                row[metric] = float(score_axes.pd.to_numeric(g[metric], errors='coerce').mean())
                row[f'{metric}_median'] = float(score_axes.pd.to_numeric(g[metric], errors='coerce').median())
                baseline = score_axes.BASELINE_FOR[metric]
                row[baseline] = float(score_axes.pd.to_numeric(g[baseline], errors='coerce').mean())
            grouped.append(row)
            curve_rows.append(row)
        level_df = score_axes.pd.DataFrame(grouped).sort_values('stress_rank')
        split_counts = level_df['n'].tolist()
        measured_order = level_df['feature_median'].is_monotonic_increasing
        if axis.get('stress_direction') == 'low':
            measured_order = level_df['feature_median'].is_monotonic_decreasing
        split_valid = len(level_df) >= 3 and min(split_counts) >= 8 and bool(measured_order)
        low_perf = float(level_df.iloc[0][score_axes.PRIMARY_METRIC]) if len(level_df) else float('nan')
        level_df['ca_lddt_drop_from_low_stress'] = level_df[score_axes.PRIMARY_METRIC] - low_perf
        worst_drop = float(level_df['ca_lddt_drop_from_low_stress'].min()) if len(level_df) else float('nan')
        core = score_axes.ols_coef(work, score_axes.PRIMARY_METRIC, 'stress_rank', score_axes.CONTROL_COLS_CORE)
        broad = score_axes.ols_coef(work, score_axes.PRIMARY_METRIC, 'stress_rank', score_axes.CONTROL_COLS_BROAD)
        gdt_broad = score_axes.ols_coef(work, 'gdt_ts', 'stress_rank', score_axes.CONTROL_COLS_BROAD)
        rmsd_broad = score_axes.ols_coef(work, 'ca_rmsd', 'stress_rank', score_axes.CONTROL_COLS_BROAD)
        baseline_core = score_axes.ols_coef(work, 'baseline_ca_lddt', 'stress_rank', score_axes.CONTROL_COLS_CORE)
        endpoint = score_axes.endpoint_effect(level_df, score_axes.PRIMARY_METRIC)
        baseline_endpoint = score_axes.endpoint_effect(level_df, 'baseline_ca_lddt')

def score_followup_axes__zscore(s: score_followup_axes.pd.Series) -> score_followup_axes.pd.Series:
    s = score_followup_axes.pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')

def score_followup_axes__stress_rank_for_axis(df: score_followup_axes.pd.DataFrame, axis: dict[str, object]) -> score_followup_axes.pd.Series:

def score_followup_axes__ols_coef(df: score_followup_axes.pd.DataFrame, y_col: str, stress_col: str, controls: list[str]) -> dict[str, float]:
    cols = [y_col, stress_col] + controls
    sub = df[cols].copy()
    for col in cols:
        sub[col] = score_followup_axes.pd.to_numeric(sub[col], errors='coerce')
    sub = sub.dropna()
    if len(sub) < max(15, len(cols) * 4):
        return {'n': int(len(sub)), 'coef': float('nan'), 'partial_corr': float('nan')}
    y = sub[y_col].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    X = score_followup_axes.np.column_stack([score_followup_axes.np.ones(len(sub)), score_followup_axes.zscore(sub[stress_col]).to_numpy(dtype=float)] + [score_followup_axes.zscore(sub[c]).to_numpy(dtype=float) for c in controls])

def score_followup_axes__level_curve(work: score_followup_axes.pd.DataFrame, axis: dict[str, object], subset_name: str) -> score_followup_axes.pd.DataFrame:

        for metric in score_followup_axes.METRICS:

            row[f'{metric}_median'] = float(score_followup_axes.pd.to_numeric(g[metric], errors='coerce').median())

def score_followup_axes__effect_stats(curve: score_followup_axes.pd.DataFrame, metric: str) -> dict[str, float]:
    if len(curve) < 3:
        return {'endpoint': float('nan'), 'top_vs_lower': float('nan'), 'top_vs_middle': float('nan'), 'spearman': float('nan')}
    ordered = curve.sort_values('stress_rank')
    top_rank = ordered['stress_rank'].max()
    low_rank = ordered['stress_rank'].min()
    top = ordered[ordered['stress_rank'].eq(top_rank)]
    low = ordered[ordered['stress_rank'].eq(low_rank)]
    lower = ordered[ordered['stress_rank'].lt(top_rank)]
    middle = ordered[ordered['stress_rank'].gt(low_rank) & ordered['stress_rank'].lt(top_rank)]
    return {'endpoint': float(top[metric].iloc[0] - low[metric].iloc[0]), 'top_vs_lower': float(top[metric].iloc[0] - score_followup_axes.np.average(lower[metric], weights=lower['n'])), 'top_vs_middle': float(top[metric].iloc[0] - score_followup_axes.np.average(middle[metric], weights=middle['n'])) if len(middle) else float('nan'), 'spearman': float(ordered['stress_rank'].corr(ordered[metric], method='spearman'))}
score_followup_axes.effect_stats = score_followup_axes__effect_stats

def score_followup_axes__bootstrap_effect(work: score_followup_axes.pd.DataFrame, metric: str, n_boot: int=1000) -> dict[str, float]:
    rng = score_followup_axes.np.random.default_rng(20260531)
    vals = []
    arr = work[['stress_rank', metric]].dropna().to_numpy(dtype=float)
    n = len(arr)
    if n < 30:
        return {'mean': float('nan'), 'ci_low': float('nan'), 'ci_high': float('nan')}
    stress = arr[:, 0]
    metric_values = arr[:, 1]
    top_rank = score_followup_axes.np.nanmax(stress)
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        idx = rng.integers(0, n, n)
        sample_stress = stress[idx]
        sample_metric = metric_values[idx]
        top = sample_stress == top_rank
        lower = sample_stress < top_rank
        if top.sum() < 5 or lower.sum() < 10:
            continue
        vals.append(float(sample_metric[top].mean() - sample_metric[lower].mean()))
    vals = score_followup_axes.np.asarray([v for v in vals if score_followup_axes.np.isfinite(v)], dtype=float)
    return {'mean': float(vals.mean()) if len(vals) else float('nan'), 'ci_low': float(score_followup_axes.np.quantile(vals, 0.025)) if len(vals) else float('nan'), 'ci_high': float(score_followup_axes.np.quantile(vals, 0.975)) if len(vals) else float('nan')}
score_followup_axes.bootstrap_effect = score_followup_axes__bootstrap_effect

def score_followup_axes__score_axis_subset(df: score_followup_axes.pd.DataFrame, axis: dict[str, object], subset_name: str) -> tuple[score_followup_axes.pd.DataFrame, dict[str, object]]:
    work = df.copy()
    work['stress_rank'] = score_followup_axes.stress_rank_for_axis(work, axis)
    work = work.dropna(subset=['stress_rank', 'ca_lddt'])
    curve = score_followup_axes.level_curve(work, axis, subset_name)
    lddt = score_followup_axes.effect_stats(curve, 'ca_lddt')
    gdt = score_followup_axes.effect_stats(curve, 'gdt_ts')
    rmsd = score_followup_axes.effect_stats(curve, 'ca_rmsd')
    baseline = score_followup_axes.effect_stats(curve, 'baseline_ca_lddt')
    core = score_followup_axes.ols_coef(work, 'ca_lddt', 'stress_rank', score_followup_axes.CONTROL_CORE)
    broad = score_followup_axes.ols_coef(work, 'ca_lddt', 'stress_rank', score_followup_axes.CONTROL_BROAD)
    broad_ref = score_followup_axes.ols_coef(work, 'ca_lddt', 'stress_rank', score_followup_axes.CONTROL_BROAD_REF)
    boot_lddt = score_followup_axes.bootstrap_effect(work, 'ca_lddt')
    boot_gdt = score_followup_axes.bootstrap_effect(work, 'gdt_ts')
    counts = curve['n'].tolist()
    measured_order = curve['feature_median'].is_monotonic_increasing
    if axis.get('stress_direction') == 'low':
        measured_order = curve['feature_median'].is_monotonic_decreasing
    summary = {'subset': subset_name, 'axis_id': axis['axis_id'], 'feature': axis['feature'], 'origin': axis['origin'], 'prospective': bool(axis['prospective']), 'benchmark_only': bool(axis['benchmark_only']), 'outcome_informed': bool(axis.get('outcome_informed', False)), 'n': int(len(work)), 'n_levels': int(len(curve)), 'min_level_n': int(min(counts)) if counts else 0, 'level_counts': ','.join((str(x) for x in counts)), 'measured_order_ok': bool(measured_order), 'ca_lddt_endpoint_effect': lddt['endpoint'], 'ca_lddt_top_vs_lower_effect': lddt['top_vs_lower'], 'ca_lddt_top_vs_middle_effect': lddt['top_vs_middle'], 'ca_lddt_level_spearman': lddt['spearman'], 'gdt_ts_top_vs_lower_effect': gdt['top_vs_lower'], 'ca_rmsd_top_vs_lower_effect': rmsd['top_vs_lower'], 'baseline_ca_lddt_top_vs_lower_effect': baseline['top_vs_lower'], 'baseline_ca_lddt_level_spearman': baseline['spearman'], 'ca_lddt_core_adjusted_coef': core['coef'], 'ca_lddt_broad_adjusted_coef': broad['coef'], 'ca_lddt_broad_ref_adjusted_coef': broad_ref['coef'], 'bootstrap_ca_lddt_top_vs_lower_mean': boot_lddt['mean'], 'bootstrap_ca_lddt_top_vs_lower_ci_low': boot_lddt['ci_low'], 'bootstrap_ca_lddt_top_vs_lower_ci_high': boot_lddt['ci_high'], 'bootstrap_gdt_top_vs_lower_mean': boot_gdt['mean'], 'bootstrap_gdt_top_vs_lower_ci_low': boot_gdt['ci_low'], 'bootstrap_gdt_top_vs_lower_ci_high': boot_gdt['ci_high'], 'low_rank_ca_lddt': float(curve.sort_values('stress_rank').iloc[0]['ca_lddt']) if len(curve) else float('nan'), 'top_rank_ca_lddt': float(curve.sort_values('stress_rank').iloc[-1]['ca_lddt']) if len(curve) else float('nan')}
    return (curve, summary)
score_followup_axes.score_axis_subset = score_followup_axes__score_axis_subset

def score_followup_axes__main() -> None:
    features = score_followup_axes.pd.read_csv(score_followup_axes.FEATURE_CSV)
    results = score_followup_axes.pd.read_csv(score_followup_axes.RESULTS_CSV)
    axes = score_followup_axes.json.loads(score_followup_axes.AXIS_JSON.read_text())['axes']
    df = features.merge(results, on='target_id', how='inner', validate='one_to_one')
    df = df[df['status'].eq('ok')].copy()
    df['discovery_fold'] = df['target_id'].map(score_followup_axes.fold_for_target)
    subsets = {'full_138': df, 'discovery_fold0': df[df['discovery_fold'].eq(0)], 'confirmation_folds1_2': df[df['discovery_fold'].isin([1, 2])]}
    curves = []
    summaries = []
    for axis in axes:
        for subset_name, subset in subsets.items():
            curve, summary = score_followup_axes.score_axis_subset(subset, axis, subset_name)
            curves.append(curve)
            summaries.append(summary)
    curve_df = score_followup_axes.pd.concat(curves, ignore_index=True)
    summary_df = score_followup_axes.pd.DataFrame(summaries)

    score_followup_axes.CONTROL_JSON.write_text(score_followup_axes.json.dumps(control, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    print(summary_df.sort_values(['subset', 'ca_lddt_top_vs_lower_effect']).to_string(index=False))

    X = densify_primary_axis.np.column_stack([densify_primary_axis.np.ones(len(sub)), sub[stress_col].to_numpy(dtype=float)] + [densify_primary_axis.zscore(sub[c]).to_numpy(dtype=float) for c in densify_primary_axis.CONTROLS])

def densify_primary_axis__threshold_sweep(df: densify_primary_axis.pd.DataFrame, subset: str) -> list[dict[str, float | int | str]]:

    for q in [0.65, 0.7, 0.75, 0.8, 0.85, 0.9]:
        threshold = float(df[densify_primary_axis.AXIS].quantile(q))
        work = df.copy()
        work['top_tail'] = (work[densify_primary_axis.AXIS] >= threshold).astype(int)
        top = work[work['top_tail'].eq(1)]
        lower = work[work['top_tail'].eq(0)]

        rows.append({'subset': subset, 'tail_quantile': q, 'threshold': threshold, 'n_top': int(len(top)), 'n_lower': int(len(lower)), 'ca_lddt_top_minus_lower': float(top['ca_lddt'].mean() - lower['ca_lddt'].mean()), 'gdt_ts_top_minus_lower': float(top['gdt_ts'].mean() - lower['gdt_ts'].mean()), 'ca_rmsd_top_minus_lower': float(top['ca_rmsd'].mean() - lower['ca_rmsd'].mean()), 'baseline_ca_lddt_top_minus_lower': float(top['baseline_ca_lddt'].mean() - lower['baseline_ca_lddt'].mean()), 'seq_len_top_median': float(top['seq_len'].median()), 'seq_len_lower_median': float(lower['seq_len'].median()), 'msa_top_median': float(top['msa_log10_nonquery_rows'].median()), 'msa_lower_median': float(lower['msa_log10_nonquery_rows'].median()), 'broad_adjusted_top_tail_coef': densify_primary_axis.ols_binary_coef(work, 'ca_lddt', 'top_tail')})

def densify_primary_axis__main() -> None:
    features = densify_primary_axis.pd.read_csv(densify_primary_axis.FEATURE_CSV)
    results = densify_primary_axis.pd.read_csv(densify_primary_axis.RESULTS_CSV)

    decile_df = densify_primary_axis.pd.concat(deciles, ignore_index=True)
    threshold_df = densify_primary_axis.pd.DataFrame(thresholds)
    decile_df.to_csv(densify_primary_axis.OUT_DECILES, index=False)
    threshold_df.to_csv(densify_primary_axis.OUT_THRESHOLDS, index=False)
    full_spc = densify_primary_axis.pd.read_csv(densify_primary_axis.ROOT / 'followup_axis_curves.csv')

    full_spc.to_csv(densify_primary_axis.OUT_SPC, index=False)

    densify_primary_axis.OUT_JSON.write_text(densify_primary_axis.json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    print(densify_primary_axis.json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.PROSPECTIVE_FEATURES = ['proline_fraction', 'chou_beta_minus_helix', 'chou_turn_minus_helix', 'chou_fasman_beta_mean', 'chou_fasman_turn_mean', 'chou_fasman_helix_mean', 'polar_fraction', 'tiny_fraction', 'cys_fraction', 'abs_charge_per_residue', 'uversky_disorder_score', 'tm_helix_proxy', 'coiled_coil_sequence_proxy', 'seq_entropy', 'seq_len', 'quaternary_state']

def mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__fold_for_target(target_id: str) -> int:
    return int(mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.hashlib.sha256(target_id.encode()).hexdigest(), 16) % 3
mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.fold_for_target = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__fold_for_target

def mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__zscore(s: mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.Series) -> mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.Series:
    s = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    sd = s.std(ddof=0)
    return (s - s.mean()) / sd if sd and mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.np.isfinite(sd) else s * 0.0
mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.zscore = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__zscore

def mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__add_residuals(df: mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.DataFrame) -> mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.DataFrame:
    sub = df[['ca_lddt'] + mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.CONTROL_COLS].copy()
    for col in sub.columns:
        sub[col] = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.to_numeric(sub[col], errors='coerce')
    sub = sub.dropna()
    X = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.np.column_stack([mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.np.ones(len(sub))] + [mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.zscore(sub[c]).to_numpy() for c in mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.CONTROL_COLS])
    y = sub['ca_lddt'].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    beta, *_ = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
    out = df.copy()
    out['ca_lddt_broad_control_residual'] = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.np.nan
    out.loc[sub.index, 'ca_lddt_broad_control_residual'] = y - X @ beta
    return out
mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.add_residuals = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__add_residuals

def mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__compare_tails(work: mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.DataFrame, feature: str) -> dict[str, float | int | str]:
    vals = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.to_numeric(work[feature], errors='coerce')
    if vals.notna().sum() < 20 or vals.nunique(dropna=True) < 3:
        return {'feature': feature, 'usable': False}
    n_tail = max(8, len(work) // 5)
    failures = work.nsmallest(n_tail, 'ca_lddt_broad_control_residual')
    successes = work.nlargest(n_tail, 'ca_lddt_broad_control_residual')
    sd = vals.std(ddof=0)
    delta = (mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.to_numeric(failures[feature], errors='coerce').mean() - mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.to_numeric(successes[feature], errors='coerce').mean()) / sd
    return {'feature': feature, 'usable': True, 'n': int(len(work)), 'n_tail': int(n_tail), 'failure_minus_success_sd': float(delta), 'spearman_feature_residual': float(vals.corr(work['ca_lddt_broad_control_residual'], method='spearman')), 'failure_median': float(mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.to_numeric(failures[feature], errors='coerce').median()), 'success_median': float(mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.to_numeric(successes[feature], errors='coerce').median()), 'all_median': float(vals.median())}
mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.compare_tails = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__compare_tails

def mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__main() -> None:
    features = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.read_csv(mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.FEATURE_CSV)
    results = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.pd.read_csv(mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.RESULTS_CSV)
    df = features.merge(results, on='target_id', how='inner', validate='one_to_one')
    df = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.add_residuals(df.dropna(subset=['ca_lddt']))
    df['discovery_fold'] = df['target_id'].map(mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.fold_for_target)
    discovery = df[df['discovery_fold'].eq(0)].dropna(subset=['ca_lddt_broad_control_residual'])
    full = df.dropna(subset=['ca_lddt_broad_control_residual'])
    discovery_rows = [mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.compare_tails(discovery, f) for f in mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.PROSPECTIVE_FEATURES]
    full_rows = [mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.compare_tails(full, f) for f in mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.PROSPECTIVE_FEATURES]
    discovery_sorted = sorted([r for r in discovery_rows if r.get('usable')], key=lambda r: r['failure_minus_success_sd'], reverse=True)
    full_sorted = sorted([r for r in full_rows if r.get('usable')], key=lambda r: r['failure_minus_success_sd'], reverse=True)
    hypotheses = {'target_model_results_used_for_hypothesis_generation_only': True, 'controls_residualized': mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.CONTROL_COLS, 'discovery_fold': 0, 'confirmation_folds': [1, 2], 'discovery_n': int(len(discovery)), 'full_n': int(len(full)), 'top_discovery_separators': discovery_sorted[:10], 'top_full_separators': full_sorted[:10], 'frozen_followup_axis_plan': [{'axis_id': 'seq_intrinsic_flexible_nonhelical_composite', 'formula': 'mean percentile rank of proline_fraction, chou_beta_minus_helix, and chou_turn_minus_helix', 'rationale': 'Discovery residual failures were enriched for proline and beta/turn-over-helix composition; full residual analysis agreed on beta/turn-over-helix.', 'prospective': True, 'outcome_informed': True}, {'axis_id': 'seq_intrinsic_turn_over_helix_densified', 'formula': 'chou_turn_minus_helix quantiles', 'rationale': 'Initial frozen axis showed an adjusted high-tail degradation and matched the residual-mining signal.', 'prospective': True, 'outcome_informed': True}, {'axis_id': 'seq_intrinsic_proline_fraction', 'formula': 'proline_fraction quantiles', 'rationale': 'Discovery residual failures had the largest enrichment in proline fraction.', 'prospective': True, 'outcome_informed': True}]}
    mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.OUT_JSON.write_text(mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.json.dumps(hypotheses, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
    print(mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.json.dumps(hypotheses, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses.main = mine_outcome_informed_hypotheses__main

import numpy as summarize_expanded_external_spc__import_np

def summarize_expanded_external_spc__best_by(df: summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.DataFrame, col: str) -> summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.DataFrame:
    ok = df[df['status'].eq('ok') & (df['sample_index'] >= 0)].copy()
    ok = ok.sort_values(['target_id', col, 'sample_index'], ascending=[True, False, True])
    return ok.groupby('target_id', as_index=False).head(1)
summarize_expanded_external_spc.best_by = summarize_expanded_external_spc__best_by

def summarize_expanded_external_spc__bootstrap_diff(a: summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.ndarray, b: summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.ndarray, seed: int=7, reps: int=2000) -> dict[str, float]:
    rng = summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.random.default_rng(seed)
    a = a[summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.isfinite(a)]
    b = b[summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.isfinite(b)]
    if len(a) < 2 or len(b) < 2:
        return {'mean': float(summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.nan), 'ci_low': float(summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.nan), 'ci_high': float(summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.nan)}
    vals = []
    for _ in range(reps):
        vals.append(float(rng.choice(a, size=len(a), replace=True).mean() - rng.choice(b, size=len(b), replace=True).mean()))
    return {'mean': float(summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.mean(vals)), 'ci_low': float(summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.quantile(vals, 0.025)), 'ci_high': float(summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.quantile(vals, 0.975))}
summarize_expanded_external_spc.bootstrap_diff = summarize_expanded_external_spc__bootstrap_diff

def summarize_expanded_external_spc__zscore(s: summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.Series) -> summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.Series:
    x = summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')
    sd = x.std()
    if not summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.isfinite(sd) or sd == 0:
        return x * 0
    return (x - x.mean()) / sd
summarize_expanded_external_spc.zscore = summarize_expanded_external_spc__zscore

def summarize_expanded_external_spc__regression_coef(df: summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, float]:
    sub = df[['ca_lddt', 'flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank', 'seq_len', 'resolution']].dropna().copy()
    if len(sub) < 10:
        return {'n': int(len(sub)), 'axis_coef': float('nan')}
    y = sub['ca_lddt'].to_numpy(float)
    x = summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.DataFrame({'intercept': 1.0, 'axis_z': summarize_expanded_external_spc.zscore(sub['flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank']), 'seq_len_z': summarize_expanded_external_spc.zscore(sub['seq_len']), 'resolution_z': summarize_expanded_external_spc.zscore(sub['resolution'])}).to_numpy(float)
    coef, *_ = summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.linalg.lstsq(x, y, rcond=None)
    pred = x @ coef
    resid = y - pred
    dof = max(1, len(y) - x.shape[1])
    sigma2 = float(resid @ resid / dof)
    cov = sigma2 * summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.linalg.pinv(x.T @ x)
    se = summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.sqrt(summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.diag(cov))
    return {'n': int(len(sub)), 'axis_coef': float(coef[1]), 'axis_se': float(se[1]), 'axis_t': float(coef[1] / se[1]) if se[1] else float('nan'), 'seq_len_coef': float(coef[2]), 'resolution_coef': float(coef[3])}
summarize_expanded_external_spc.regression_coef = summarize_expanded_external_spc__regression_coef

def summarize_expanded_external_spc__summarize(selection_name: str, target: summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.DataFrame, features: summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[summarize_expanded_external_spc.pd.DataFrame, dict[str, object]]:
    df = features.merge(target, on='target_id', how='left', suffixes=('', '_metric'))
    df = df[df['status'].eq('ok') & df['ca_lddt'].notna()].copy()
    group = df.groupby(['external_axis_level', 'external_axis_level_name']).agg(n=('target_id', 'count'), entries=('entry_id', 'nunique'), rank_mean=('flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank', 'mean'), rank_min=('flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank', 'min'), rank_max=('flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank', 'max'), seq_len_mean=('seq_len', 'mean'), seq_len_median=('seq_len', 'median'), resolution_median=('resolution', 'median'), ca_lddt_mean=('ca_lddt', 'mean'), ca_lddt_median=('ca_lddt', 'median'), gdt_ts_mean=('gdt_ts', 'mean'), ca_rmsd_median=('ca_rmsd', 'median'), ptm_mean=('ptm', 'mean'), plddt_mean=('plddt_mean', 'mean')).reset_index().sort_values('external_axis_level')
    top = df[df['external_axis_level'].eq(4)]['ca_lddt'].to_numpy(float)
    lower = df[df['external_axis_level'].lt(4)]['ca_lddt'].to_numpy(float)
    low = df[df['external_axis_level'].eq(0)]['ca_lddt'].to_numpy(float)
    rho_level = summarize_expanded_external_spc.spearmanr(df['external_axis_level'], df['ca_lddt'], nan_policy='omit')
    rho_rank = summarize_expanded_external_spc.spearmanr(df['flexible_nonhelical_composite_rank'], df['ca_lddt'], nan_policy='omit')
    effect = {'selection': selection_name, 'n': int(len(df)), 'levels': int(group['external_axis_level'].nunique()), 'top_level_n': int(len(top)), 'lower_levels_n': int(len(lower)), 'top_minus_lower_ca_lddt': float(summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.nanmean(top) - summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.nanmean(lower)), 'top_minus_low_ca_lddt': float(summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.nanmean(top) - summarize_expanded_external_spc.np.nanmean(low)), 'top_minus_lower_gdt_ts': float(df[df['external_axis_level'].eq(4)]['gdt_ts'].mean() - df[df['external_axis_level'].lt(4)]['gdt_ts'].mean()), 'top_minus_lower_ca_rmsd_median': float(df[df['external_axis_level'].eq(4)]['ca_rmsd'].median() - df[df['external_axis_level'].lt(4)]['ca_rmsd'].median()), 'spearman_level_vs_ca_lddt_rho': float(rho_level.correlation), 'spearman_level_vs_ca_lddt_p': float(rho_level.pvalue), 'spearman_rank_vs_ca_lddt_rho': float(rho_rank.correlation), 'spearman_rank_vs_ca_lddt_p': float(rho_rank.pvalue), 'bootstrap_top_minus_lower_ca_lddt': summarize_expanded_external_spc.bootstrap_diff(top, lower), 'length_resolution_adjusted_regression': summarize_expanded_external_spc.regression_coef(df)}

def draw_calculated_curves(frame,title):
    level=next((c for c in ['axis_level','level','stress_rank','external_axis_level','charge_level','acidic_window_level','cys_level','viral_disulfide_score','envelope_fusion_score','surface_lowhelical_score','quartile'] if c in frame),None)
    metric=next((c for c in ['ca_lddt_mean','target_ca_lddt_mean','mean_ca_lddt','ca_lddt'] if c in frame),None)
    if level is None or metric is None:return
    axis=next((c for c in ['axis_id','axis_name','axis','feature'] if c in frame),None)
    frame=frame.copy();frame['_feature']=frame[axis].astype(str) if axis else title
    for start in range(0,frame['_feature'].nunique(),9):
        names=frame['_feature'].unique()[start:start+9]
        fig,axes=plt.subplots((len(names)+2)//3,3,figsize=(14,3.7*((len(names)+2)//3)),squeeze=False,layout='constrained')
        for ax,name in zip(axes.flat,names):
            sub=frame[frame['_feature']==name]
            groups=[c for c in ['subset','source','selection','selection_policy','direction','inference_setting'] if c in sub]
            for key,part in (sub.groupby(groups,dropna=False,sort=False) if groups else [('all',sub)]):
                part=part.sort_values(level)
                ax.plot(part[level],part[metric],marker='o',markersize=3,label=str(key))
            ax.set(title=str(name),xlabel=level,ylabel=metric)
            if groups:ax.legend(fontsize=5)
        for ax in list(axes.flat)[len(names):]:ax.axis('off')
        buffer=io.BytesIO();fig.savefig(buffer,format='png',dpi=120);plt.close(fig);display(Image(data=buffer.getvalue()))
for name,frame in calculated_tables.items():
    if 'curve' in name:draw_calculated_curves(frame,name)

6. What the agent decided, and why¶

The decision below is calculated from the available level curves. A decline is identified only when increasing stress lowers the level mean; uncertainty and adjusted controls above determine how strongly that direction is supported.

# Report decisions from the statistics just calculated above.
decision_rows=[]
for filename,frame in calculated_tables.items():
    if 'curve' not in filename:continue
    level=next((c for c in ['axis_level','level','stress_rank','external_axis_level','charge_level','acidic_window_level','cys_level','quartile'] if c in frame),None)
    metric=next((c for c in ['ca_lddt_mean','target_ca_lddt_mean','mean_ca_lddt','ca_lddt'] if c in frame),None)
    if level is None or metric is None:continue
    groups=[c for c in ['axis','axis_id','axis_name','feature','subset','source','selection','direction'] if c in frame]
    for key,part in (frame.groupby(groups,dropna=False,sort=False) if groups else [('all',frame)]):
        part=part.dropna(subset=[metric,level]).sort_values(level)
        if len(part)<2:continue
        contrast=float(part.iloc[-1][metric]-part.iloc[0][metric])
        decision_rows.append({'curve':filename,'group':str(key),'last_minus_first':contrast,'direction':'lower accuracy at higher stress' if contrast<0 else 'no endpoint decline','strictly_decreasing_level_means':bool(np.all(np.diff(part[metric])<0))})
decision_table=pd.DataFrame(decision_rows)
display(decision_table)
if decision_table.empty:raise RuntimeError('No calculated curve available for interpretation')
for filename,frame in calculated_tables.items():
    status_columns=[c for c in ['decision','status','screen_decision'] if c in frame]
    if status_columns:
        identifiers=[c for c in ['axis','axis_id','feature','source','subset'] if c in frame]
        values=[c for c in frame if any(key in c for key in ['effect','coef','ci_low','ci_high'])]
        display(Markdown('**Calculated screen decisions: '+filename+'**'))
        display(frame[identifiers+status_columns+values])
confirmation_names={3:'flexible107',4:'charge97',5:'acidic78',6:'cysteine95'}
if AXIS_NUMBER in confirmation_names:
    name=confirmation_names[AXIS_NUMBER]
    effects=json.loads(Path(analysis_result['artifacts'][name+'_effects.json']).read_text())
    primary=next(x for x in effects if x.get('selection',x.get('selection_policy'))=='best_by_ptm')
    estimate=float(primary['top_minus_lower_ca_lddt'])
    interval=primary.get('bootstrap_top_minus_lower_ca_lddt') or {}
    upper=interval.get('ci_high',np.nan)
    adjustments={k:v for k,v in primary.items() if 'adjust' in k and isinstance(v,dict)}
    coefficients=[v.get('axis_coef',v.get('coef',np.nan)) for v in adjustments.values()]
    available=[float(x) for x in coefficients if x is not None and np.isfinite(x)]
    supported=estimate<0 and upper is not None and np.isfinite(upper) and upper<0 and bool(available) and all(x<0 for x in available)
    decision='retain this cohort-specific decline' if supported else 'reject a supported general decline on this axis'
    print(f'Decision: {decision}. Top-minus-lower CA-lDDT={estimate:+.4f}; bootstrap interval={interval}; adjusted coefficients={available}.')
    print('The sample-selection controls and source-specific curves above delimit this conclusion; an oracle selection is diagnostic and is never the primary decision.')
else:
    print('Decision: retain only the specific supported subsets identified by the calculated screen decisions above. A pooled endpoint decline alone does not establish a general failure across settings or biological contexts; source-specific curves, intervals, baseline movement, and adjusted controls delimit each finding.')
